scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic transfer and formal generating-function proof, with reproducible finite enumeration; no unverified infinite computational extrapolation. Historical originality is qualified and independent validation is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Only the prime two, the two specified binomial-coefficient families, and complete dyadic initial blocks. Existing asymptotic covariance and Gaussian limit laws are prior work. Full historical-priority coverage is incomplete because an important 1984 article was not accessible as full text.
title: Exact finite-block joint two-adic valuations of two binomial coefficients
